Theme

Computing & programming

internet noun

also the internet, the net, the web, World Wide Web, connection (computer), internet connection

modern

Traupman 261, 334

interrēte, interrētis n.

noun, third declension

Traupman’s word, built on rēte, a net, and declined like it: ablative interrēte (Lewis & Short gives rēte as the commoner ablative of rēte, beside rētī). The adjective is interrētiālis (see online, website); in talk rēte alone will do.

Other words

  • Tēla Tōtīus Terrae — the World Wide Web

    also used · modern · Traupman 262, 408

    Traupman’s name for the Web, abbreviated TTT, as WWW is in English.

  • rēte ūniversāle — the worldwide net

    also used · modern · Andresian p. 14; Traupman 405

    Rēte is the classical net (Lewis & Short).

  • cōnexus, cōnexūs m. — (computer) connection

    noun, fourth declension · also used · modern · Traupman 295

  • interrētiālis, interrētiāle — internet (adjective), online

    declension · also used · modern · Traupman 334

See also website, network, online, offline.
